recognition.summary: Previously unknown, sufficiently serious findings may receive opt-in credit under the disclosure policy.

reporting.summary: The official policy provides direct email reporting with PGP encryption; an institutional Report Assistant is also available.

rewards.summary: The reviewed policy does not promise monetary rewards.

limitations: This is a government coordination service; current constituency and disclosure rules control.
The Report Assistant displayed an encryption-unavailable notice in text review; submission was not tested.
Premature public disclosure can lead to removal of credit.
